text: Since the start of the year, residents have contacted my office to share concerns regarding dangerous speeding along Brock Avenue, between College Street and Cobourg Avenue. This stretch is home to two schools, Brock Public School and St. Helen Catholic School, and is currently the only part of Brock in my ward without traffic calming measures. In a resident poll, there was significant support for speed humps. My office also consulted with local school leadership, and they are supportive of these needed changes. I respectfully request your support on the following recommendations.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Waived the polling requirement under the City's Traffic Calming Policy and authorized the installation of traffic calming (speed humps) on Brock Avenue, between College Street and Cobourg Avenue. 2. Directed the City Solicitor to prepare a by-law to alter the roadway to install four speed humps on Brock Avenue, between College Street and Cobourg Avenue, generally as shown on Attachment 1 to the letter (November 13, 2023) from Councillor Alejandra Bravo.
